candidate.definition_en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to a person, activity, or cause.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تدي كل وقتك ومجهودك لحاجة معينة أو لشخص بتحبه، يعني تكرس حياتك ليه.

senses.definition_en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to a person, activity, or cause.
senses.definition_ar: يُكرّس وقته أو موارده لشخص أو نشاط أو قضية.
examples: You should devote more time to your studies if you want to pass.
The committee decided to devote the entire budget to community healthcare.
Many scientists devote their lives to finding a cure for the disease.
